{{Quote|You remember Kalveck, the art dealer? She marched right into the square with her credit box held high. Handed it to the Regulator sergeant. He took the box, thanked her and shot her dead.|A citizen of Talaos City|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Kalveck''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] art dealer who lived in [[Talaos City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], prior to the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. When the [[InterStellar Regulators]] took over the [[City/Legends|city]], Kalveck attempted to bribe the Regulators with her [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit box]], but the Regulator [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] shot her [[Death/Legends|dead]] after taking the box.
